weekly_theme.summary: 這段期間沒有特別重大的星象事件，是適合按自己步調安排生活的一週。

aries.horoscope: 你有注意到有新鄰居搬進來嗎，白羊座？這個人可能來自一個迷人的地方，因此值得自我介紹。但是，今天可能不是聊天的最佳時機，因為他們可能會全神貫注於打開行李並安頓下來。考慮烘焙一些餅乾，並在接下來的幾天內送達；你會很高興你採取了主動。
aries.horoscope_en: Are you noticing a new neighbor moving in, Aries? This individual might hail from a fascinating place, making it worthwhile to introduce yourself. However, today may not be the best time for a chat, as they could be preoccupied with unpacking and getting settled. Consider baking some cookies and delivering them in the next few days; you'll be pleased you took the initiative.

taurus.horoscope: 金牛座，你是否注意到你的消費習慣有點失控？今天，你可能會開始感受到壓力。看來你可能需要推遲長期以來的購買，這可能會有點煩人。但沒必要緊張！您可以順利處理此情況，當您的財務狀況恢復正常時，該令人垂涎的項目仍可供選擇。深呼吸，放鬆身心。
taurus.horoscope_en: Taurus, have you noticed your spending habits getting a bit out of hand? Today, you might start to feel the pinch. It seems you may need to hold off on that long-desired purchase, which could be a bit annoying. But there's no need to stress! You'll navigate this situation just fine, and that coveted item will still be available when your finances are back on track. Take a deep breath and unwind.

gemini.horoscope: 今天，你的伴侶可能看起來有點沮喪，可能沒有心情討論它，雙子座。這可能會激怒你，因為你更喜歡透明。抵制窺探的衝動；推動他們敞開心扉可能會創造距離，而不是親密。要有耐心，讓你所愛的人在準備好時分享他們的感受。
gemini.horoscope_en: Today, your partner might appear a bit down and may not be in the mood to discuss it, Gemini. This could be a source of irritation for you, as you prefer transparency. Resist the urge to pry; pushing them to open up could create distance instead of closeness. Be patient and allow your loved one to share their feelings when they feel ready.

cancer.horoscope: 癌症，你可能會發現自己今天經歷了一些神祕的疼痛和不適，讓你覺得有點不舒服。這些感覺很可能沒有明確的原因，所以盡量不要急於得出負面的結論。不適可能只是源於神經緊張和壓力加劇。退後一步，讓自己今天放鬆身心；明天你可以恢復正常的活動。
cancer.horoscope_en: Cancer, you might find yourself experiencing some mysterious aches and discomfort today, leaving you feeling a bit off. It’s likely that these sensations have no clear cause, so try not to jump to negative conclusions. The discomfort may simply stem from heightened nerve tension and stress. Take a step back and allow yourself to unwind today; you can return to your regular activities tomorrow.

leo.horoscope: 今天，獅子座，為你浪漫生活中的一些打嗝和驚喜做好準備。你可能會發現嫉妒潛入，讓你覺得你的伴侶好像在看別人。請記住，這些感受可能具有誤導性，現實情況可能與您的看法不一致。保持專注，在獲得所有資訊之前，不要下任何結論。
leo.horoscope_en: Today, Leo, be prepared for a few hiccups and surprises in your romantic life. You might find jealousy creeping in, leading you to feel as though your partner has their eye on someone else. Remember, these feelings could be misleading, and the reality may not align with your perceptions. Keep your focus sharp and hold off on making any conclusions until you have all the information.

virgo.horoscope: 處女座，你可能會發現自己在家裡經歷了一些意想不到的變化，無論是意外維修還是來來往往的新面孔。你的生活空間可能會感到有點混亂和雜亂，直到一切都找到自己的位置，這可能會讓你對寧靜的偏好感到不安。請記住，逐步處理任務並密切關注最終目標將是您的最佳策略。這種方法將有助於保持您的安心！
virgo.horoscope_en: Virgo, you might find yourself navigating some unexpected shifts at home, whether it's surprise repairs or new faces coming and going. Your living space could feel a bit chaotic and cluttered until everything finds its place, which can be quite unsettling for your preference for tranquility. Remember, tackling tasks gradually and keeping your eyes on the end goal will be your best strategy. This approach will help maintain your peace of mind!

libra.horoscope: 今天，天秤座，你可能會接到一通意想不到的電話，而這並不是你所希望的。可能是您不喜歡的人，或帶來令人不安的消息的人。無論您對來電者的感受或他們的訊息為何，您似乎都需要參與此次對話。無論您對此有何感受，您都可能會意識到解決手頭問題的重要性。
libra.horoscope_en: Today, Libra, you might receive an unexpected phone call that isn't exactly what you were hoping for. It could be from someone you’re not fond of or someone bringing unsettling news. Regardless of your feelings towards the caller or their message, it seems you'll need to engage in this conversation. No matter how you feel about it, you’ll likely recognize the importance of addressing the matter at hand.

scorpio.horoscope: 天蠍座，最近一直困擾著你的任何財務問題都可能是毫無根據的。這種認識可能會帶給你一種解脫感，即使需要一點時間來沉浸其中。你的想法可能仍在影響你完全接受這個好消息的能力。如有需要，歡迎隨時查看您的電子郵件和銀行對帳單；結論將保持一致，事實上情況比您預期的要好。
scorpio.horoscope_en: Scorpio, any financial concerns that have been weighing on your mind recently might turn out to be baseless. This realization will likely bring you a sense of relief, even if it takes a moment to sink in. Your thoughts may still be clouding your ability to fully embrace this good news. Feel free to review your emails and bank statements as often as you need; the conclusion will remain consistent – things are actually better than you anticipated.

sagittarius.horoscope: 射手座，你可能會因為與另一半的短暫距離而感到有點不安。你是否擔心你的朋友可能會忽略你？這種反應可能有點誇張，因為你的不安全感可能會模糊你的判斷力。尋找分散注意力的地方，讓你的思緒保持忙碌。相信一切都會好起來的。來自好友的電話可能會帶給您一些安慰。 在你的伴侶回來之前，繼續參與活動可能是解決這個問題的最佳方式。
sagittarius.horoscope_en: Sagittarius, you might find yourself feeling a bit unsettled due to a brief distance from your significant other. Are you anxious that your friend might be overlooking you? This reaction may be a bit exaggerated, as your insecurities could be clouding your judgment. Seek out a distraction to keep your mind occupied. Trust that everything will be alright. A call from your friend is likely to bring you some comfort. Staying engaged in activities until your partner is back might be the best way to navigate through this.

capricorn.horoscope: 感覺有點不知所措，摩羯座？隨著一連串的責任和許多人尋求你的專注，你的壓力水平可能會達到頂峯。走到外面休息一下是很重要的。盡情享用美味外賣餐點，或在網上享受零售療法。不要低估清爽小睡的力量。請記住，現在感到緊迫的事情不值得犧牲你的安寧。留意獎品！
capricorn.horoscope_en: Feeling a bit overwhelmed, Capricorn? With a flurry of responsibilities and numerous individuals seeking your focus, your stress levels might be reaching their peak. It's essential to step outside for a breather. Indulge in a delicious takeout meal or enjoy some retail therapy online. Don't underestimate the power of a refreshing nap. Remember, the things that feel pressing right now aren't worth compromising your tranquility. Keep your eyes on the prize!

aquarius.horoscope: 今天，水瓶座，你可能會發現自己被一股創造性的能量所淹沒，讓你遠離平常的社交活動。你可能會以這樣的強度投入你的工作，以至於覺得沒有時間可以浪費了，因為如果你不立即捕捉到這些想法，你就會害怕失去你的才華橫溢的想法。雖然無情地向前推進很誘人，但請記得儲備零食，並短暫休息以充電。 保持專注，祝你工作順利！
aquarius.horoscope_en: Today, Aquarius, you might find yourself swept up in a wave of creative energy that pulls you away from your usual social activities. You may dive into your work with such intensity that it feels like there’s no time to waste, driven by the fear of losing your brilliant ideas if you don’t capture them immediately. While it’s tempting to push forward relentlessly, remember to stock up on snacks and take short breaks to recharge. Stay focused and best of luck with your endeavors!

pisces.horoscope: 如今，隨著一些令人愉快的驚喜房客抵達，您的房源可能會成為自發聚會的場所。擁抱當下，同時掌控局面。對話可能會從輕鬆的玩笑轉向更深入、更有意義的主題。如果氛圍正確，慶祝活動可能會持續到深夜，但請注意不要讓它超出樂趣。請記住，總會有另一個機會一起慶祝。
pisces.horoscope_en: Today, your home might become the setting for a spontaneous gathering as some delightful surprise guests arrive. Embrace the moment while keeping things in check. The dialogue is likely to swing from lighthearted banter to deeper, more meaningful topics. If the vibe is right, the festivities could stretch late into the evening, but be mindful not to let it drag on beyond the fun. Remember, there will always be another opportunity to celebrate together.
